title: Pacer's Claude price history
description: The dated Claude prices Pacer prices usage with: https://pacer.andrechek.com/claude-prices.json (the app reads the same file at /price-history.json). Curated records (`records`) are reviewed by hand against Anthropic's pricing page and release notes; the price list (`catalog`) is merged from public price catalogs every six hours. Which record prices a moment: among the records whose window holds it, for the same model, provider, region, speed and tier, a curated record wins, except that an open-ended curated record loses to a price-list record with other numbers that opened after `asOf` (or the record's `reviewedAt`); then the later start. Documentation: https://pacer.andrechek.com/claude-prices/.

asOf.description: When the curated records were last reviewed: every curated record's `reviewedAt` unless it has its own.

source.description: Where the curated prices are checked.

records.description: Curated records. Provider, region, speed and tier default to the Claude API's own (anthropic, global, standard, 0).

catalog.description: The price list: catalog prices merged and dated once, on Pacer's side, by .github/workflows/price-catalog-sync.yml. A record opens only when a price changes, dated by the run that saw it, and the record it replaces closes at that instant.

changedAt.description: When a record was last opened or closed.

checkedAt.description: When the sync last confirmed the list (at least weekly). Ten days without one and the app stops trusting the list's open records.

day.description: A UTC day: YYYY-MM-DD means midnight UTC.

instant.description: A UTC day or an ISO 8601 instant.

model.description: The model id without a date suffix, lowercase: claude-opus-5-5.

speed.description: fast: an explicit fast-mode price, which wins over a standard record's fastMultiplier.

tierAbovePromptTokens.description: 0 for the base rate. Otherwise a request whose prompt (input, cache reads and both cache writes) is above this many tokens takes these rates for the whole request.

fastMultiplier.description: Fast mode costs this many times the standard rates (every category).

regionalMultiplier.description: A regional or multi-region endpoint on a cloud platform (from the 4.5 models), or US-only data residency on the Claude API (inference_geo, Claude 4.6 and later only), costs this many times the standard rates.

reviewedAt.description: Overrides asOf as this record's review date.

source.description: The catalog the merged price came from.

derived.description: Cache-write rates the catalogs did not publish, derived from the input rate (5 minutes: 1.25×, 1 hour: 2×).
